text:
maya: Heads up — nightly eval fired ~6 suites failing for rwd-v2-int4 on the hosted fleet. Dash: https://dash.internal/redwood/evals/2790012345 :eyes:
nightly-bot: [alert] 6/23 suites failed, severity: medium, alert_id=NE-2790012345 :rotating_light:
maya: initial surface: failures are concentrated on prefix-coherence and long-context QA cohorts, lots of empty or truncated continuations.
frank: can you paste the failing prompt ids? any common token prefixes?
maya: sample IDs: pfx-443, pfx-447, pfx-450. All show truncated answer after few tokens. Example generation: "" (empty). Logs attached in job 2790012345-logs.
eli: quick check — looks like a serializer/deserializer mismatch between the new quantized checkpoint and the KV cache format. Saw this in a local repro:
```
ERROR kvcache: deserialize failed: invalid varint sequence
WARN runtime: kvcache length 0, falling back to full forward
```
eli: that varint error typically means the serialized kvcache header changed (we changed chunk ordering in quant pipeline last week).
sophie: we updated tokenizer merges in modelcard v2 last patch — could be tokenization shift causing earlier stop tokens?
frank: two independent plausible causes: tokenizer merge id shift or kvcache/serializer mismatch. Which one matches the failing cohorts?
maya: cohort histogram: long-context QA failures align with kvcache deserial errors in logs; prefix-coherence shows token shift traces. So both might be happening but different cohorts dominated by each.
ops-bot: runbook note: assign oncall + eng-ml to investigate.
maya: assigning owners: frank for kvcache path, eli for quant-serializer, sophie for tokenizer hypothesis. Severity set to P2 (user-visible but partial).
frank: immediate mitigation: rollback serializer change in the serving image and re-run smoke on canary pool (10% traffic). I'll kick off canary rollback now.
frank: @nightly-bot starting rollback job rwd-rollback-2790012345 (canary).
nightly-bot: rollback job queued -> job id rwd-rollback-2790012345-1, ETA ~8m.
eli: meanwhile I'll run a small reproduce script against the new checkpoint with the old serializer to confirm repro and capture failing KV bytes. Command: `python tools/repro_kvcache.py --model rwd-v2-int4 --prompt pfx-443`.
sophie: I'll diff tokenizer vocab between v1 and v2 and run the promptset through both tokenizers to see tokenization drift.
maya: good. If rollback fixes kvcache cohort we can promote and then follow with serializer compatibility test in CI. Also need an eval assertion guarding deserial errors.
frank: update: canary rollback finished, canary smoke passed for 200 samples, kvcache deserial errors dropped to 0. Rolling to 50% while we monitor. :thumbsup:
eli: repro confirmed locally — the new serializer writes little-endian varints while runtime expects big-endian (oops). I'll open PR to make serializer endian-neutral + add unit test.
sophie: tokenizer diff shows 3 merged pairs changed which shift tokens for some rare prefixes — will open a separate PR to pin tokenizer in modelcard for the short-term and add tokenization parity test.
maya: plan: (1) keep rollback active until serializer PR lands and passes internal CI; (2) merge serializer fix + unit tests; (3) add kvcache deserial assertion to nightly; (4) pin tokenizer for rwd-v2-int4 until regen verified. Owners: frank (rollout/ops), eli (serializer fix), sophie (tokenizer pin + tests).
frank: logging action items in the incident board. Marking this as mitigated->monitoring.
maya: thanks all. Re-open if regressions reappear. :pray:
